title: 第5章  这小子疯了
content_zh:
楚家院子。
楚山打量着楚弛，好一会才开口问道：“你，是修者了？”
他的问题，也是所有楚家人的问题。
楚弛骄傲一笑：“不错，我已成为修者。”
“什么，真的是修者！”
楚家人虽然已经猜到了，却还是觉得惊讶。
有人皱眉道：“一个修炼废物，居然也开辟出了丹田？我还是不相信。”
这话出，楚弛眼神猛然一冷，以前，别人叫他废物，看不起他，他只能忍。
但现在，他不需要忍了。
既然他也成为了修者，还忍你妈的蛋啊！
楚弛双脚一踏，快速去到骂他废物的楚家五少爷楚南的面前。
没有丝毫征兆，猛然一巴掌落下。
这一巴掌，谁都没有预料到。
一声脆响。
楚南虽然是凡人境四层的修为，在没有防备的情况下，也被打肿了脸，
他眼睛瞪得大大的，似乎被打懵逼了。
懵逼之后，楚南怒了！
“你这个有爹娘生，没爹娘养的东西，居然敢打我！今天不弄死你，老子不是楚南！”
体内的灵气，全部被楚南调动在右拳之上
下一刻，他冲向了楚弛。

他的右拳，发光发亮。
一拳出，好似有老虎在咆哮。
“这是猛虎拳！居然有虎啸声，楚南将猛虎拳小成了！”
“什么？猛虎拳小成！这么说，现在的楚南有越层对敌的实力。”
“这一拳要是落在楚弛的脑袋上……不好，他是真想杀了楚弛！”
楚南的拳头，带起呼啸风声，击向了楚弛的脑袋。
楚弛微微皱眉，身为楚家人，他自然知道猛虎拳有多大威力。
这可是人级中品武技。
他刚刚成为修者，对自己的实力还不大清楚，他没有硬拼，双脚一踏，快速退开。
“废物想逃？你逃得了！”
楚南冷冷一笑，身体像是轻鸿，快速追了上去。
似乎不打爆楚弛的头，他就不罢手一样！
楚弛当时就怒了，妈的，真以为自己还是以前那样好欺负吗？
不跑了！
楚弛的脑海里，下意识浮现起了女剑仙传给他的剑道传承。
女剑仙的剑道传承，绝对精妙，可以被称为神通秘术！
就算楚南的修为比他高一层，还学成了人级中品武技，他也有自信能击败楚南。
只是不知道，他能不能施展出来，毕竟，他还没有练习过剑术。
但管那么多干什么，先试试再说，反正不能坐以待毙。
他摘下院子里一枚树枝，以枝为剑，正准备施展剑技。

一直没有动静的楚山，忽然出现在他身前，一把抓住了楚南的手腕。
“爷爷……你别拦我。这废物趁我不备，居然打我的脸！我必须弄他！”
楚南捏紧拳头，还是很生气。
被楚弛打脸，简直就是人生奇耻！
从小到大，只有他欺负楚弛，哪有楚弛欺负他的份？
楚山没有说话，他将另外一只手搭在楚弛的肩膀上，灵气渗透而入。
随后他才开口道：“三条隐脉，凡人境三层的修为，怪不得能击败庞妃烟。但你不是楚南的对手，这样，你道个歉吧。”
“道歉？”楚弛眼神桀骜不驯，他冷笑道，“他嘴贱，该打！”
楚山摇了摇头道：“你小子，嘴挺倔，那你可知道，我要是不拦下他，他一拳可打爆你的脑袋。”
“我只知道，我一路赶回楚家，身体很疲惫。他现在对我出手，就是趁人之危。”
话落，楚弛看向楚南，嘲讽一般地道。
“楚南，你要是真不服气，想弄我！我给你这个机会，等我休息一晚。明天，你我堂堂正正来一场战斗，如何？”
楚弛这话一出，四周围观的小伙伴们全部惊呆了！
“楚弛是不是疯了？他居然主动同楚南约战！”
“凡人境三层，想对抗凡人境四层。痴人说梦！何况，楚南还小成了人级中品武技。”
“楚弛，是在找死！”
人级武技，对应凡人境。
分为上品，中品，下品，和少见的极品。
人级下品武技，凡人境一层及其以上修者可以学习。
人级下品武技的威力，最大也不过相当于凡人境四层，偶尔有妖孽能发挥出凡人境五层的力量。但极少极少，可以忽略不计。

人级中品武技，以此类推。凡人境四层以上可以学习……大部分人，六层才能将之入门。威力最大，不过凡人境八层。
上品武技，凡人境七层以上可以学习。
极品武技，凡人境巅峰修者可学。一旦学会，有资格对抗下一个大境界的修者。
“楚弛，你说什么？你要堂堂正正和我战一场？哈哈哈，好啊，这可你自己说的，千万别反悔！”
楚南哈哈大笑。
楚弛严肃地道：“绝不反悔！”
“好，那我就给你一晚上休息的时间。要是一晚不够，三天五天也可以！”
“不用，一晚足以！明天太阳升起，我会去你的院子找你。”
这一晚，楚弛打算学习剑术。
时间虽然短，但他觉得，应该够了。
女剑仙对他的要求，是一年之内，将修为提升到魔人境。
这说明，他的天赋，非常强大，否则，女剑仙也不会这样要求他。
“爷爷，你听见了，不是我欺负他，是他自己同我约战的。那我就回去等你。”
楚南的话落，已经转身离去。
他一走，四周的人也先后散去。
等大部分人离开后，楚山再次朝楚弛开口道。
“夜郎自大，你根本不是楚南的对手。这一战，你必败！罢了，我会让他手下留情，但挨一顿打，你肯定是免不了的。”
楚弛没有解释，他知道，爷爷并不看好他，解释也没用。
明日，用事实说话！
“对了，你说的庞家的事情，到底是不是真的？”楚山再次开口。

楚弛这才回答道：“爷爷，我知道你其实是信我的。但我楚家的实力，要弱于庞家一些，如果真同庞家动手，那是杀敌一千，自损一千，所以，哪怕是真的，你也只能当做假的。”
“你小子，心里倒是明白得很。但，我就算不能找庞家的麻烦，也得给你出这口气。”
“爷爷，怎么出？”
“你说的事情，日落之前，定然会传遍整个村子。”
“多谢爷爷，这已经够了。至于庞家和庞飞烟，我自己会解决的。这事情，绝对没完！”
楚山好奇地问道：“你解决？你怎么解决？”
“当然是，灭了庞家！”
楚弛眼里有光，声音铿锵。
庞家，是一定要灭的。
不灭庞家，他又怎么让庞妃烟当头牌呢？
content_en:
Chu family courtyard.
Chu Shan looked at Chu Chi for a while and then asked: "Are you a cultivator?"
His problem is also the problem of all the Chu family.
Chu Chi smiled proudly: "Yes, I have become a cultivator."
"What, he is really a cultivator!"
Although the Chu family had already guessed it, they were still surprised.
Someone frowned and said, "A waste of cultivation actually developed a Dantian? I still don't believe it."
When these words came out, Chu Chi's eyes suddenly turned cold. In the past, others called him a waste and looked down on him, but he could only endure it.
But now, he doesn't need to endure it anymore.
Now that he has become a cultivator, why can't he bear it?
Chu Chi stepped on his feet and quickly went to Chu Nan, the fifth young master of the Chu family who called him a waste.
Without any warning, a slap fell suddenly.
No one expected this slap.
There was a crisp sound.
Although Chu Nan was at the fourth level of the mortal realm, he was beaten in the face without any precautions.
His eyes were wide open and he seemed stunned.
After being confused, Chu Nan became angry!
"How dare you hit me, a creature with parents but no parents! If I don't kill you today, I won't be Chu Nan!"
All the spiritual energy in the body was mobilized by Chu Nan on his right fist
The next moment, he rushed towards Chu Chi.
His right fist was shining brightly.
With one punch, it seemed like a tiger was roaring.
"This is the Tiger Fist! There is actually a roar of a tiger. Chu Nan made the Tiger Fist smaller!"
"What? A small success in the Tiger Fist! So Chu Nan now has the strength to fight the enemy across multiple levels."
"If this punch lands on Chu Chi's head... no good, he really wants to kill Chu Chi!"
Chu Nan's fist hit Chu Chi's head with a roaring sound.
Chu Chi frowned slightly. As a member of the Chu family, he naturally knew how powerful the Tiger Fist was.
This is a mid-level human-level martial skill.
He had just become a cultivator and was not very clear about his own strength. He did not fight hard, but stepped away with both feet.
"Trash wants to escape? You can escape!"
Chu Nan smiled coldly, and quickly caught up with him like a scorpion.
It seems like he won't stop until Chu Chi's head is blown off!
Chu Chi was angry at that time. Damn it, do you really think that you are still as easy to bully as before?
No more running!
In Chu Chi's mind, the sword inheritance passed down to him by the female sword fairy emerged subconsciously.
The female swordsman's inheritance of swordsmanship is absolutely exquisite and can be called a magical secret technique!
Even if Chu Nan's cultivation level is one level higher than him and he has learned human-level mid-level martial arts, he is still confident that he can defeat Chu Nan.
I just don't know if he can perform it. After all, he hasn't practiced swordsmanship yet.
But why do you care so much? Try it first and then talk about it. Anyway, you can't sit still and wait for death.
He picked off a branch in the yard, used the branch as a sword, and was about to use his sword skills.
Chu Shan, who had been silent all this time, suddenly appeared in front of him and grabbed Chu Nan's wrist.
"Grandpa... don't stop me. This loser took advantage of me and hit me in the face! I have to get him!"
Chu Nan clenched his fists, still very angry.
Being slapped in the face by Chu Chi is simply a shame in life!
Growing up, he was the only one who bullied Chu Chi, how could Chu Chi bully him?
Chu Shan didn't speak. He put his other hand on Chu Chi's shoulder, and the spiritual energy penetrated.
Then he said: "With three hidden veins and a cultivation level of the third level of the mortal realm, no wonder you can defeat Pang Feiyan. But you are no match for Chu Nan. In this case, you should apologize."
"Apologise?" Chu Chi's eyes were unruly, and he sneered, "He's a bitch, he deserves a beating!"
Chu Shan shook his head and said: "You boy, you are very stubborn, but do you know that if I don't stop him, he will blow your head off with one punch."
"All I know is that I rushed all the way back to the Chu family and was very tired. He is taking advantage of others' danger by attacking me now."
After finishing his words, Chu Chi looked at Chu Nan and said mockingly.
"Chun Nan, if you are really dissatisfiedAngry, you want to mess with me! I'll give you this chance while I take a night off. Tomorrow, you and I will have a serious battle, how about it? "
As soon as Chu Chi said these words, all the friends watching were stunned!
"Is Chu Chi crazy? He actually took the initiative to make a fight with Chu Nan! "
“The third level of the mortal realm wants to fight against the fourth level of the mortal realm. Idiot's dream! What's more, Chu Nan has achieved human-level mid-level martial arts at a young age. "
"Chu Chi is looking for death! "
Human-level martial arts correspond to the mortal realm.
It is divided into top grade, medium grade, low grade, and rare top grade.
Low-level human-level martial arts can be learned by cultivators of the first-level mortal level and above.
The power of human-level low-level martial arts is at most equivalent to the fourth level of the mortal realm. Occasionally, monsters can exert the power of the fifth level of the mortal realm. But it's so rare that it can be ignored.
Intermediate human-level martial arts, and so on. It can be learned by people above the fourth level of the mortal realm... Most people can only get started with it by the sixth level. The most powerful, but only the eighth level of the mortal realm.
High-grade martial arts can be learned by people above the seventh level of the mortal realm.
The ultimate martial arts can be learned by cultivators at the top of the mortal realm. Once you learn it, you will be qualified to fight against the cultivators of the next great realm.
"Chu Chi, what did you say? Do you want to fight me openly? Hahaha, okay, you said it yourself, don’t go back on it! "
Chu Nan laughed.
Chu Chi said seriously: "I will never regret it! "
"Okay, then I'll give you one night to rest. If one night is not enough, three or five days will do! "
"No, one night is enough! When the sun rises tomorrow, I will go to your yard to find you. "
This night, Chu Chi planned to learn swordsmanship.
Although the time was short, he felt that it should be enough.
The female sword fairy's request for him is to upgrade his cultivation to the demon realm within one year.
This shows that his talent is very powerful, otherwise, the female sword fairy would not ask him like this.
"Grandpa, you heard me, it wasn't me who bullied him, it was him who made the fight with me. Then I'll go back and wait for you. "
After Chu Nan finished speaking, he turned around and left.
As soon as he left, the people around him also dispersed.
After most people left, Chu Shan spoke to Chu Chi again.
"Yelang is arrogant, you are no match for Chu Nan. You will lose this battle! Forget it, I will ask him to be merciful, but you will definitely not be able to avoid a beating. "
Chu Chi didn't explain. He knew that grandpa didn't think highly of him, and explanations were useless.
Tomorrow, let the facts speak!
"By the way, what you said about the Pang family is true? "Chu Shan spoke again.
Chu Chi then replied: "Grandpa, I know you actually believe in me. But the strength of our Chu family is weaker than that of the Pang family. If we really fight against the Pang family, we will kill a thousand enemies and lose a thousand ourselves. Therefore, even if it is true, you can only treat it as a lie. "
"You kid, you understand very well. However, even if I can't cause trouble for the Pang family, I still have to give you this tone. "
"Grandpa, how come? "
"What you said will definitely spread throughout the village before sunset. "
"Thank you, grandpa, that's enough. As for the Pang family and Pang Feiyan, I will solve it myself. This matter is definitely never over! "
Chu Shan asked curiously: "You solve it? How do you solve it? "
"Of course, destroy the Pang family! "
Chu Chi's eyes were bright and his voice was sonorous.
The Pang family must be destroyed.
If the Pang family is immortal, how can he let Pang Feiyan take the lead?
